zombies.skeptic_notes: The original was closed by a crew at creation ('Internal Case Performed by Highway Maintenance crew'), and the re-report is another staff-entered case (Employee Generated) opened about 1 minute later at 14 m. This is how a crew logs several defects fixed in one visit, one case each; it is not evidence that the first pothole came back. The re-report is 14 m from the original, matched by radius only (no street segment in this run).

The re-report was entered by city staff (Employee Generated) 12 days later, for example on a patrol; staff log every pothole they find, including new ones at spots they already know. Both cases carry the identical point for the intersection of Forest Hills St & Lourdes Ave: an intersection centroid, which marks the intersection, not the defect. Records at this point can describe a pothole on any approach.
